blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The ePMP™ Force 180 5 GHz subscriber module is the next generation of the ePMP 5 GHz Integrated Radio, offering a higher-gain, integrated 16 dBi patch antenna.


Installation and alignment are easy with the adjustable mounting bracket, and the Force 180 is small, sleek, and equipped witha  Gigabit Ethernet port to deliver the maximum throughput.

The Cambium Networks ePMP 180 is a cost-effective and efficient 5GHz wireless radio built for Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) deployments. With an integrated 16 dBi directional antenna and up to 200 Mbps throughput, it is ideal for subscriber modules (SM) or small PTP links in rural and suburban areas.

The ePMP 180 is part of Cambium's reliable ePMP ecosystem, providing QoS, GPS sync, and interference-tolerant performance at a budget-friendly price. Designed to ensure high availability, scalability, and easy remote management, it is perfect for ISPs, SMEs, and surveillance applications.


Key Features:

  • Frequency Band: 5.150 – 5.970 GHz

  • Built-in Antenna: 16 dBi directional panel

  • Max Throughput: 200 Mbps

  • GPS Synchronization: Yes

  • QoS Support: Triple play (voice, video, data)

  • TDD Mode: Configurable

  • Outdoor IP55-rated enclosure

  • Web GUI and remote management support

  • Compatible with ePMP Access Points and LinkPlanner


Link Distance:

  • Typical PTMP Range: 3 – 10 km (Line-of-sight)

  • Short PTP Links: 5 – 8 km (depending on alignment and conditions)


Use Cases:

  • ISP last-mile access

  • Small office/home wireless broadband

  • Wireless CCTV backhaul

  • Industrial automation

  • Campus/building wireless bridging
